description: Stable clause map for traceable Core-agent authoring prompts. Role meaning remains owned by Shared/roles/*.md.

role_guardrails.CORE1: Follow the current CORE1 contract for compact semantic orientation.
role_guardrails.CORE2: Preserve source custody and exact source identity; do not present authored material as supplied source.
role_guardrails.CORE1A: Preserve full intrinsic subtopic depth; learner percentage must not shrink what is taught.
role_guardrails.CORE1B: Preserve the same intrinsic concept depth as CORE1A while following its attempt/reconstruction contract.
role_guardrails.CORE2A: Use learner estimate only as permitted for routing/support; never treat it as prerequisite or mastery evidence.
role_guardrails.CORE2B: Preserve changed-demand transfer and prerequisite checks; aggregate percentage never establishes readiness.
